stories.headline: North Carolina sawtimber prices lag as pulpwood gains diverge
stories.body: North Carolina’s third-quarter standing-timber prices remained below year-earlier levels for most sawtimber products, North Carolina State Extension reported October 26. Statewide pine chip-n-saw fell 16%, pine sawtimber 11% and pine ply…

stories.headline: Spring seedling orders remain open as some species sell out
stories.body: Minnesota’s State Forest Nursery has updated its spring 2027 price list with several species sold out, including white cedar, bur oak and silver maple. Red pine, white pine and white spruce in the five-to-twelve-inch class remain listed…
